about: Protocol v4 section 1.4: V4's golden example, computed by hand with 30-digit decimals (not by fno code). Session variances are squared log returns summed over a session, overnight included (dimensionless). Implied volatility is annualised on the calendar clock (365 days); both sides are compared as annualised volatility per 252 sessions.

cases.name: weekend inside the window: 7 calendar days, 5 sessions
weekend and a holiday: 9 calendar days, 5 sessions
